# WP3.5 metric requests

`requests.json` retains the 35 explicit requests from the WP3.4 completion
diagnostics: seven metrics for each of Apple, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and
JPMorgan, with actual intervals and the 2026-10-21 cutoff.

These are regression inputs, not independently verified financial ground truth.
The expected coverage remains 31 selected, three unsupported and one unavailable.
No missing metric is substituted or calculated from HTML tables.
